visualCharacteristics.purpose: Horizontal header row of top-level section links (Credit Cards, Banking, Lending, Investing, Wealth Management, Travel & Benefits, Open an Account)

contentPattern.structure: a bulleted list of links in one cell, or one link per cell/row; a list item with a nested list becomes a dropdown (button + submenu)

usage: Header component: top-level navigation links. Standalone block; the site header is migrated separately and may embed this content.
reuseGuidance: Use for any single-level (optionally one nested level) horizontal link row. Not a mega-menu.
